 Versus  The State of Bihar & Anr.

For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Rajiv Ranjan Kumar Pandey, Advocate  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Md. Ataur Rahman, APP  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE KHATIM REZA  ORAL ORDER 2 11-12-2024 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.
2.

Learned counsel for the petitioner seeks permission to add the name of informant as O.P. No. 2,
in course of the day.

3. The petitioner apprehends arrest in connection with Buxar (Industrial Area) P.S. Case No. 72 of 2017 dated 14.04.2017, instituted for the offence punishable under Sections 406, 420 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 138 of N.I. Act.
4. Issue notice to the opposite party no. 2 under speed post with A/D as well as through ordinary process, for which requisites etc. must be filed within one week.
5.

This case be listed upon on receipt of service report or appearance of the opposite party no. 2,
whichever is earlier Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.83667 of 2024(2) dt.11-12-2024 among the top five cases.
6.
In the meantime, no coercive steps shall be taken against the petitioner in the present case.
